name: Anzu
source:
[b]“You’ve changed, Kaito.”[/b]

Anzu is a woman who has grown up in a very rough environment, making her mannerisms resemble those of a man, and having a tough exterior. Deep inside though, Anzu is a kind and innocent girl. 

She’s on the lookout for Kaito, who disappeared from her life one year ago, and is now working as Kyouka’s bodyguard in order to survive on “the other side” while she looks for him.

Hobbies: Anzu doesn’t have any particular hobbies.
Likes: Anzu doesn’t really have anything that she likes in particular.
Dislikes: What Anzu dislikes more than anything though is being left alone.

[From [url=https://daybreaktl.wordpress.com/projectoverview/meet-the-characters]Daybreak Translations[/url]]
